## Université du Québec à Montréal

### [ECO7036 — Économétrie I](https://etudier.uqam.ca/cours?sigle=ECO7036)

Master's level. The general linear regression model; generalized least squares
and maximum likelihood estimation; multicollinearity, specification error,
autocorrelated residuals, stochastic regressors and measurement error;
distributed lag and autoregressive models; systems of simultaneous equations.

### [ECO9036 — Macroéconométrie](https://etudier.uqam.ca/cours?sigle=ECO9036)

Doctoral level. Estimation and inference problems specific to macroeconometrics:
specification tests, univariate and multivariate stationary time series,
non-stationarity and cointegration, dynamic adjustment models, GMM and simulated
method of moments, and numerical simulation methods. Applications are drawn from
current debates in real, monetary and financial macroeconomics.
